text: May Canady, a veterinary assistant [teased as a child for her lazy eye|origin|harm done in childhood], keeps only one friend: Suzie, a doll her mother made her and told her never to take out of its glass case. She falls for the mechanic Adam and his hands, flirts with her colleague Polly and her beautiful neck, and [is pushed away by both|wrong|abandonment and rejection]. When Suzie's case shatters, May takes her mother's advice to make a friend and sets about [gathering the parts she loves best|wants|to be loved and belong] for [a patchwork doll of her own|images|dolls, masks and likenesses].
